fact: Police said on 22 September 2026 they would prosecute Jerry Nyantee Wrato on four alleged violations of the Cybercrime Act of 2025 (sections 10.1, 15.1, 18.1, 19.1) over AI-generated material about the Vice President; Criminal Court B ordered him released on a writ of habeas corpus the same day.
title: Wrato Released: Liberia's Cybercrime Law Faces a Constitutional Stress
